title: ActivityWidget
wrapsNative: MonarchWidget (a Monarch card on androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with a Material 3 DropdownMenu and a View all button) holding a compact MonarchActivityTimeline (an androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of event rows) with a bounded height
summary: A recipe, not a component: the recent-activity card of a dashboard, a MonarchWidget around a compact MonarchActivityTimeline of the latest few events, with View all leading to the full log.
whenToUse: On a dashboard or a home screen that shows what changed recently, when the full activity log is another screen.
whenNotToUse: For the full log or an audit trail, open a screen with MonarchActivityTimeline on its own. For the person's own notifications, use the notification center pattern.
api: MonarchWidget(title = …, onViewAll = …) { MonarchActivityTimeline(events = events.take(6), modifier = Modifier.heightIn(max = …), groupByDay = false, density = MonarchActivityTimelineDensity.Compact, loading = …, now = …, labels = MonarchActivityTimelineLabels(list = …, empty = …)) }

states.name: ready
states.description: The first events, newest first. Pass only the latest few (the web default is 6); View all opens the rest.

states.name: loading
states.description: Pass loading = true to the timeline so the card shows the timeline's own placeholder rows under the widget's title.

states.name: empty
states.description: The timeline shows its empty text; set labels.empty to "No activity yet" or the product's wording.

states.name: failed
states.description: Set the widget's state to MonarchWidgetState.Failed() with onRetry: the card shows the error with Try again instead of the timeline.

appearance: The widget's surface and subtle border with its title row, then the compact timeline: tone-coloured dots or avatars, the sentence in the default text color and the time in the muted text color. The same roles change with dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ActivityWidget is a component with a limit prop and its own "Recent activity" and "No activity yet" strings. On Android, as on iOS, it is a recipe of MonarchWidget and MonarchActivityTimeline: the app passes the first events (events.take(6)) and its own title, already localised, so Monarch ships no strings for it. The web view-all link is an href; on Android onViewAll is a callback the app uses to navigate to the full log. The Android timeline is a LazyColumn, unlike the iOS VStack, so inside a scrolling dashboard it needs a bounded height (Modifier.heightIn(max = …)); in a widget of a non-scrolling grid it can fill the space it is given. The web timeZone prop is the timeline's timeZone parameter.
accessibility: The widget title is a TalkBack heading, then each event is read as one sentence: actor, verb, target and time.
Automated actors carry the visible "Automated" tag from the timeline, so people and rules are told apart without color.
View all and Try again are Material 3 buttons with 48dp touch targets.
edgeCases: Keep the list short: pass five or six events and lead to the full log; more scroll inside the bounded height.
Pass now and timeZone from a fixed clock in tests and previews so relative times and day groups do not change between runs.
Ungrouped (groupByDay = false) reads better in a short card; grouped by day suits a taller widget.

examples.template:
MonarchWidget(title = {{title}}, onViewAll = {}) {
    MonarchActivityTimeline(
        events = listOf(
            MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
                id = {{events.0.id}},
                verb = {{events.0.verb}},
                time = {{events.0.time|millis}},
                actor = MonarchActivityTimelineActor({{events.0.actor}}),
                target = {{events.0.object}},
        ),
        MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
            id = {{events.1.id}},
            verb = {{events.1.verb}},
            time = {{events.1.time|millis}},
            actor = MonarchActivityTimelineActor({{events.1.actor}}, kind = MonarchActivityTimelineActorKind.{{events.1.kind|pascal}}),
            target = {{events.1.object}},
            tone = {{events.1.tone|tone}},
        ),
        MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
            id = {{events.2.id}},
            verb = {{events.2.verb}},
            time = {{events.2.time|millis}},
            actor = MonarchActivityTimelineActor({{events.2.actor}}),
            target = {{events.2.object}},
        ),
        MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
            id = {{events.3.id}},
            verb = {{events.3.verb}},
            time = {{events.3.time|millis}},
            actor = MonarchActivityTimelineActor({{events.3.actor}}),
            target = {{events.3.object}},
        ),
        ),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(max = 320.dp),
        groupByDay = false,
        density = MonarchActivityTimelineDensity.Compact,
        now = {{now|millis}},
        timeZone = {{timeZone}},
        labels = MonarchActivityTimelineLabels(list = {{title}}),
    )
}
